source: Solo artists with more and less Spotify followers compared to their band
claim: Eleven solo artists have more Spotify followers than their band: Beyoncé, Justin Timberlake, Camila Cabello, Romeo Santos, Ricky Martin, Nick Jonas, SUNMI, Omarion, Robbie Williams, HyunA and Marques Houston.
code:
(m.dropna(subset=['followers'])
 .merge(b[['name','followers']], left_on='band', right_on='name', suffixes=('_member','_band'))
 .assign(gap=lambda d: d.followers_member-d.followers_band)
 .query('gap > 0')
 .sort_values('gap', ascending=False)
 .assign(n=lambda d: len(d))
 [['n','spotifyName','band','gap']])

source: ⚠️ Spoiler alert: Beyoncé did alright without her posse.
claim: Beyoncé has 26,199,288 Spotify followers and 51 Hot 100 hits, against Destiny's Child's 4,629,097 followers and 13 hits.
code:
(m[m.name.str.startswith('Beyoncé')]
 .merge(b[b.name == "Destiny's Child"], left_on='band', right_on='name', suffixes=('_member','_band'))
 .assign(artist=lambda d: d.spotifyName_member,
         solo_followers=lambda d: d.followers_member,
         band_followers=lambda d: d.followers_band,
         solo_hits=lambda d: d.ranks_member.str.count(r'\d+'),
         band_hits=lambda d: d.ranks_band.str.count(r'\d+'))
 [['artist','band','solo_followers','band_followers','solo_hits','band_hits']].T)

source: A solo act like Harry Styles—who at present has fewer followers than One Direction—is clearly in the midst of his ascent, and is likely to make up some of that ground.
claim: Harry Styles has 12,813,873 Spotify followers, fewer than One Direction's 20,067,462.
code:
(m.merge(b[['name','followers']], left_on='band', right_on='name', suffixes=('_member','_band'))
 .query("name_member == 'Harry Styles'")
 .assign(gap=lambda d: d.followers_member-d.followers_band)
 [['name_member','band','followers_member','followers_band','gap']])

source: But the real takeaway is and always has been Beyoncé. She remains head and shoulders above the rest, with her 51 top 100 hits.
claim: Beyoncé Knowles has 51 Billboard Hot 100 hits, more than any other band or solo artist; One Direction is next with 29.

source: How many times every band and its members charted on the Billboard Hot 100
claim: Billboard Hot 100 hit counts per band and solo artist range from 1 to 51, with Beyoncé at 51, One Direction at 29, Justin Timberlake at 22, Jonas Brothers at 21, and BTS and Boyz II Men at 17 each.
No. 1 Hot 100 hit counts per band and solo artist range from 0 to 5, with Beyoncé at 5, and Boyz II Men, Destiny's Child, TLC and Justin Timberlake each at 4.
code:
(pd.concat([b[b.name.isin(m.loc[m.ranks.notna(), 'band'])].assign(role='band'),
            m[m.ranks.notna()].assign(role='member')])
 .assign(artist=lambda d: d.spotifyName.fillna(d.name),
         ones=lambda d: d.ranks.fillna('').str.split('|').apply(lambda xs: sum(x.strip()=='1' for x in xs)))
 .sort_values('ones', ascending=False)
 [['artist','role','ones']])
